subject: Intermittent 503s — availability apportionment & log digest request
messages:
From: Sofia Morales <sofia@zephyrpay.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: ZephyrPay Support <support@zephyrpay.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 16:34:12 -0700
Subject: Intermittent 503s and request for availability apportionment

Hi Irene,

We saw a spike of 503 responses against our Redwood integration yesterday evening (rough window: 2029-05-21 20:02:00 - 20:18:00 UTC and a smaller recurrence at 21:07:00 - 21:12:00 UTC). This impacted our checkout flow and led to several failed transactions.

We've pulled a small sample of our client-side traces and are attaching a compressed log bundle (zephyr_logs_20290521.tgz) — it contains request ids and timestamps for the failures. Can you confirm whether these windows meet Redwood's SLA downtime/apportionment rules and what the next steps are for a credit calculation? We also need a target date for a postmortem suitable for our security/compliance team.

Relevant context: we are on a committed Dedicated plan, routed to us-west-2. Our billing contact is CC'd.

Thanks,
Sofia Morales
Head of Platform — ZephyrPay
sofia@zephyrpay.com

Attachments: zephyr_logs_20290521.tgz (log bundle, 38MB)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Morales <sofia@zephyrpay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s and request for availability apportionment

Hi Sofia — thanks for the heads-up and for sending the bundle. I've got the logs and will triage with Marcus and engineering to validate the exact impact window against our telemetry.

Immediate items:
- Marcus: can you confirm whether the two windows you listed correspond with an availability gap on our side (us-west-2 Dedicated pool)? If so, please pull raw ingress/egress traces and a short tail-latency histogram for the 30-minute period around 20:00 UTC.
- Laura: I'll loop finance once we have the validated downtime window so we can run the apportionment and credit calculation against ZephyrPay's contract.

Can you also upload the raw request ids to the shared drive link (or paste the HubSpot record id) so we can cross-reference when we assemble evidence for credits? We'll aim to confirm eligibility and an initial timeline for the postmortem within 24 hours.

Appreciate the context — we'll follow up with an evidence summary and next steps.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

Attachment note: I referenced your zephyr_logs_20290521.tgz and added it to the incident folder.

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 18:30:14 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: ZephyrPay — validate windows & prepare digest

Marcus / Aditya — looping you in to validate and prepare the evidence bundle for ZephyrPay. Details from tenant and external bundle below.

What I need from infra/serving:
- Confirm whether our control plane or Dedicated GPU pool had eviction/preemption events in us-west-2 for 2029-05-21 20:00:00 - 20:30:00 UTC and 21:00:00 - 21:15:00 UTC.
- Extract raw server-side request logs and the KV-cache hit/miss rates for the two windows. Include trace ids that map to zephyr request ids.
- Provide a short provenance summary (are these hardware preemptions, autoscaler overshoot, routing failover, or transient auth errors?).

Aditya — can you also pull a 1-minute trace sample (core runtime traces) and include any backpressure or queuing metrics? If you can attach a small JSON (trace_sample_20290521.json) that would help speed validation.

Laura — once Marcus confirms the validated downtime window, can you produce a pro-rata apportionment estimate and the contract clause we're applying? ZephyrPay is on a monthly committed tier; they want to understand the credit path and timeline.

I'm copying HubSpot record: ZP-3921 and a Drive folder where the customer dropped the logs. I'll collate and send the evidence bundle to Sofia once we have confirmation.

Thanks — please mark priority as P1 for the support queue.

— Irene

From: Sofia Morales <sofia@zephyrpay.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: ZephyrPay Support <support@zephyrpay.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s and request for availability apportionment

Thanks, Irene — appreciate the quick response. I've uploaded the expanded archive (contains client traces and our reconciliation snippets) to the Drive link you referenced and added the HubSpot note ZP-3921.

Two asks from ZephyrPay: please confirm by EOD (a) whether the two windows you see are eligible for SLA apportionment under our Dedicated contract, and (b) the estimated credit amount or the calculation methodology. We also need an estimated date for the postmortem write-up and a single point of contact for the RCA.

If helpful, we can schedule a brief 30-minute call to walk through the timelines once you have the validated windows.

Regards,
Sofia
Head of Platform — ZephyrPay

Attachments: none (logs uploaded to shared Drive)
